explanation: A righteous man from the line of David who was engaged to Mary and became Jesus' earthly father.
The mother of Jesus, a young virgin from Nazareth who received a visit from the angel Gabriel regarding her conception.
A small town in Galilee where Joseph and Mary lived before traveling to Bethlehem for the census.
The city where David was born and where Jesus came into the world, known as "the city of David".
An official count of the population under Emperor Augustus that forced Joseph and Mary to travel from their home.
The moment when the prophecies about the coming of the Messiah were to be fulfilled in history.
A heavenly being sent by God to bring messages to people, here specifically to the shepherds and Mary.
Simple men who were watching their flocks in the fields outside Bethlehem when they first received the news of Jesus' birth.
A feeding trough or container for animal feed where Jesus was placed after he was born, because there was no room at the inn.
An accommodation or guesthouse where travelers could stay overnight, but which was full at this time.
A celestial body that led the wise men from the east to Bethlehem to find the newborn king.
Wise men or astrologers from the east who followed the star and brought gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
The concept that Jesus is God's Son who took on a human life to save the world.
